name: gcwork
description: Connects the local Codex and Claude Code to WorkBuddy. Four tiers — plan, hard, main, chore — pick the model and reasoning effort for each task; planning stays read-only and separate from execution.

displayDescription.en: Plugs your local Codex and Claude Code in. Four tiers pick the model; you just talk.
displayDescription.zh: 接入本机 Codex 与 Claude Code，四档调度自动选模型，对话即可调用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先判断这个任务的复杂度：简单的直接干；复杂或高风险的话，先给我方案，我确认后再改代码。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Judge the complexity first: just do it if it's simple; if it's complex or risky, show me the plan before touching code.

quickPrompts.zh: 先判断这个任务的复杂度：简单的直接干；复杂或高风险的话，先给我方案，我确认后再改代码。
quickPrompts.en: Judge the complexity first: just do it if it's simple; if it's complex or risky, show me the plan before touching code.

quickPrompts.zh: 这个问题比较棘手，用攻坚档定位根因，给出最小修复并跑相关测试。
quickPrompts.en: This one is tricky — use the hard tier to find the root cause, apply the smallest fix, and run the relevant tests.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是个小活，用杂活档处理，只改必要的文件，把验证结果告诉我。
quickPrompts.en: Small job — use the chore tier, touch only the files that must change, and tell me how you verified it.
